findings.title: CONTEXT.md's new "Source-corrected work" entry still describes the PRE-FIX mechanism: it promises a successor and a `superseded` refusal for EVERY retired Work, which is false on two of the three retire arms
findings.evidence: The entry was written in the lane's FIRST #885 commit `63358cd19` and was never revisited by the fix round: `git log --oneline 23cfad94..HEAD -- CONTEXT.md` returns `63358cd19` alone, while `git log --name-only c5d3bec54^..HEAD -- CONTEXT.md apps/web/messages/en.json` shows the fix round touching `en.json` TWICE (`894d2dd6c`, `e4d742151`) and CONTEXT.md never. Its committed text (CONTEXT.md, `<!-- #885 -->`) reads: "every work of that firm still waiting on a question about that document -- and holding no committed receipt -- is restated: cancelled with the reason source corrected and SUPERSEDED BY A FRESH WORK on the same admitted basis... The retired question can no longer be answered; the answer door refuses it as SUPERSEDED AND NAMES THE SUCCESSOR." MEASURED on clara_l09, both clauses are false for the no-successor arms. Probe 1 (clara.revise_document_fact driven in a transaction that was then ROLLED BACK; rollback control re-read every row afterwards and found all six unmoved): the `clara_interpreted` Work went awaiting_input -> stopping with `superseded_by = NULL`, no successor row (`select ... where supersedes = <work>` empty), and its `work.cancelled` domain event carried `outcome: "cancelled"`, `superseded_by: null` -- not `superseded`. Probe 2 (committed) drove the answer door on the equally successorless `source_already_posted` arm: `answer_work_question` refused CLR13 with `detail.reason = "cancelled"`, `detail.current.superseded_by = null`. This is the SAME false universal the fix round removed from `WorkQuestion.convergeSuperseded` under L09-ADV-02/L09-SPEC-01 ("the sentence says what is true of every path that reaches it"); AGENTS.md names CONTEXT.md as the source of truth for naming concepts, so the stale copy is the one future work will read.
findings.required_fix: Reword the CONTEXT.md `#885` entry to the shipped mechanism, applying the fix round's own rule: every affected Work is RETIRED; a successor is admitted only when `basis_origin = 'user_direct'` AND the restatement door accepts it; otherwise the Work is cancelled with no successor, `superseded_by` stays null and the answer door says `cancelled`. One paragraph; no code change.

findings.title: The ruling's "re-admitted ON THE CORRECTED FACTS" is delivered on NO arm: the `user_direct` successor is admitted carrying the retired basis verbatim, cannot post the corrected figure, and CAN post the pre-correction one -- measured end to end -- and no successor contract names who re-derives a corrected basis
findings.evidence: MEASURED on clara_l09, probe 3 (committed). A Work parked on a question about document `0422a84b`, `basis_origin = 'user_direct'`, basis lines 64000 cents, against a document reading RM 640.00. `clara.revise_document_fact` corrects `invoice.total` to RM 999.00 (facts_version 2; the live `clara.document_regions` row for `invoice.total` now reads `text_content 'RM 999.00', monetary_cents 99900`). The door admits successor `d45cdaf3` with `basis cents = 64000` and `basis_digest 43c7e6481376` -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to the retired Work's (probe 1 asserts the same equality on its own pair). Driving the successor's run through the real wake lane: posting the CORRECTED figure 99900 is REFUSED `CLR10 {"reason":"basis_mismatch"}`; posting the STALE figure 64000 is ACCEPTED, `posted=true`, entry `186c1947-028e-44d7-8a0a-6dd05f44bdfc`, status `approved`, `clara.journal_lines` = [6100 dr 64000][1150 cr 64000], and `clara.entry_evidence_links` binds that entry to document `0422a84b`, whose live `invoice.total` is RM 999.00. So the exact shape of adversarial blocker L09-ADV-01 -- a successor structurally able to post ONLY the pre-correction figure against the corrected document -- survives on the `user_direct` arm; the fix removed it from the `clara_interpreted` arm only. This is NOT a regression of the blocker's own remedy (L09-ADV-01's `required_fix` says in terms "A `user_direct` basis is the human's own instruction and may be carried forward"), and it is disclosed at the two surfaces that meet it (`WorkQuestion.convergeSuperseded`: "The replacement carries the same admitted instruction... a figure that has to change needs a new restatement"; `ClientDocuments.factsRevisionWorkReplaced`: "One continued as new work carrying the same instruction."). What is missing is the RECORD: neither the 0268 header, nor `packages/db/README.md`'s 0268 section, nor `wave2-lane09-fix.md` §6's three successor contracts names the re-derivation step, and `git diff 23cfad94..HEAD | grep -i 'claraWork_v6|chatTurn_v22|wave 4|re-derive'` returns only unrelated prestate-drift messages. §6's contracts are (1) a first-class cancellation reason on 0199's door, (2) a better sentence keyed on it, (3) the `SupersededWork` type -- all about the REASON and the SENTENCE, none about deriving a corrected basis. Nothing forces a human to look at the successor before it runs either: probe 3's successor was `queued` with `pending_question_id = null`, and `clara.list_review_queue` for that client returned 3 rows, none naming the retired Work or the successor (`row_kind` present: `uncoded_filing` only) -- so the brief's line "Needs-you shows the replacement" is measurably not delivered (the lane records this as L09-SPEC-08, deliberately left).
findings.required_fix: Do not close #885 as DONE. Close it PARTIAL (or leave it open) with the remainder stated in the ticket's own words, and add the missing successor contract to `wave2-lane09-fix.md` §6 and to 0268's "WHAT THAT SHAPE DOES NOT GIVE" paragraph: WHO re-derives a basis from corrected facts, at which cut (the wave-4 `chatTurn_v22` / `claraWork_v6` shared cut is the only lane that can interpret a document), and what the door should do in the meantime with a `user_direct` successor whose admitted figures were never re-confirmed after the correction. No code change is required from this lane.

findings.title: A pending question about the corrected document is STILL ANSWERABLE when its Work holds a committed receipt -- measured ACCEPTED -- and neither a cell nor the report says so
findings.evidence: MEASURED on clara_l09, probe 2 (committed), built through the real verbs exactly as the lane's own `w885.posted.untouched` cell builds it: Work `56aba783` parked on question `c6f13bb6` citing document D, then posting through `wake_record_journal_entry` (1 committed receipt; the Work stays `awaiting_input` with the question `pending`). `clara.revise_document_fact` then corrects `invoice.total` to RM 999.00: `superseded_work` is `[]` for that Work and `[{replaced:false, not_replaced_reason:'source_already_posted'}]` for its unposted sibling, as carve-out (c) intends. The residue: answering the POSTED Work's question afterwards SUCCEEDS -- `clara.answer_work_question` returned `{status:'answered', answered_role:'bookkeeper', question_version:1}` -- i.e. a person answered a question asked about a reading that had just been corrected, which is the literal thing the owner's 2026-09-20 ruling says must never happen. The carve-out is the Agent Brief's own ("Works already holding a committed receipt are untouched (#676's territory)") and the ruling says that brief "stands unchanged", so the two halves of the owner's own ruling contradict each other here. The lane never surfaces it: `w885.posted.untouched` asserts the Work's status, `superseded_by`, receipts and the absence of a successor, but never re-drives the answer door, and `wave2-lane09-fix.md` does not list this among the paths it leaves open.
findings.required_fix: Add one assertion to `w885.posted.untouched` pinning that the question is still answerable after the correction (so the carve-out is visible in the evidence rather than discoverable only by probing), and put the contradiction to the owner on #885 in one line: the brief carves out a posted Work, the ruling says nobody may answer against a corrected reading, and today the carve-out wins.

summary: PART 1 -- every finding above note severity in the three reports is fixed on head 3a4e34315, re-verified by running rather than from the fix report's prose, and nothing else broke. Adversarial: L09-ADV-01 closed at the admission seam (the interpreted arm admits nothing; probe 1 re-measured it under a rolled-back correction) and at the surface (`SourceRevisionWorkEffect` renders the receipt's `superseded_work` on the correcting page); ADV-02/SPEC-01 the `convergeSuperseded` sentence now asserts no source correction and no corrected figures; ADV-03 CLR10/CLR13 are caught per Work in a subtransaction and the correction commits (probe 2 re-measured a sibling's posted entry no longer refusing a bookkeeper's correction, facts_version 1 -> 2); ADV-04 `client-work-pack.ts:307` now sends `status: dates === null ? ["completed"] : []`; ADV-05/06 and SPEC-03/10 `WorkCards.tsx` has exactly ONE restate mount left (line 232, `offerRestate = bookkeeperPlus && !onOwnWorkDetail`, the duplicate `RestateWorkPanel` deleted); ADV-07 `workRowClaimLabel` tests `typeof claim !== "string" || claim === ""`; ADV-08 both gate modules exist and both are in `packages/db/package.json`'s chain in migration order; ADV-09/10 kept as argued. Spec: SPEC-04 AC2 has a render cell, SPEC-05 the claim label is on the always-visible `work-row-wide-line`, SPEC-06/07/08/09 recorded, SPEC-12 `grep 'reader contract' 0268` returns 0. Standards: STD-1a/1b/1c `packages/db/README.md` gains `## 0265`, `## 0266`, `## 0267`; STD-2 falls with the deleted mount. Gates re-run here: db battery (work-question-admitted-basis + work-list + client-work-pack + work-source-correction-supersede + rig-docs-source-revision + preintegration-gate-chain + operation-census + rig-isolation) under the exact 54-module gate chain on clara_l09 = 110 tests, 109 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (rig-isolation T19, which needs CLARA_RIG_ALLOW_RESET); the 12 touched web unit files = 148/148 pass, exit 0; the WHOLE apps/web suite (the lane edits shared harness `test/hookHarness.ts`, so this is the real regression check) = 4772 tests, 4770 pass, 0 fail, 2 skipped, exit 0, no flake this run; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm lint` exit 0; `CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint` exit 1 on EXACTLY one case -- the freeze-lint selftest's `--retire` under CI case -- and `git diff BASE..HEAD -- scripts/check-frozen-workflows.selftest.mjs scripts/check-frozen-workflows.mjs` is empty, so it is not this lane's (already fixed on the integration branch by f6d828b2c). `git status --porcelain` is empty and HEAD is unmoved at 3a4e34315. PART 2 -- #885 as built honours the ruling's non-negotiable half for the population the rule names, and honours the second half ("re-admitted on the corrected facts") on no arm at all. Two stale paths remain, both measured by driving the real doors: a `user_direct` successor posted the pre-correction RM 640.00 against a document whose live reading is RM 999.00 and was accepted, and a person answered a pending question about the corrected document on a Work holding a committed receipt. The first is the shape the adversarial blocker described, narrowed to the arm that blocker's own required_fix blessed; the second is the brief's own #676 carve-out contradicting the ruling's absolute sentence. Neither is a regression this lane introduced and both are disclosed to the person at the surfaces that meet them, so the code is mergeable; what is not honest is closing #885 as DONE. Four findings open, all minor or note: a CONTEXT.md entry left describing the pre-fix mechanism, the unrecorded successor contract for basis re-derivation, the unpinned answerable carve-out, and the out-of-lane commit the integrator must dedupe.

ruling_885.delivered: The ruling's NON-NEGOTIABLE half is delivered for the population the rule names: every Work of the firm that is queued/running/awaiting_input, holds a pending question, cites the corrected document in its own source_refs and holds no committed receipt is RETIRED inside the correcting transaction, its question closes, and answering it is refused CLR13. That is real and re-measured here, including the ADV-03 fix that stops a sibling Work's refusal aborting the human's correction. The ruling's SECOND half -- 're-admitted ON THE CORRECTED FACTS' -- is delivered on NO arm. On the clara_interpreted arm there is no successor at all. On the user_direct arm there IS a successor, but it is re-admitted on the OLD facts: its basis and basis_digest are byte-identical to the retired Work's, so it may post ONLY the pre-correction figure (MEASURED: 99900 refused CLR10 basis_mismatch, 64000 accepted and committed as entry 186c1947 against a document now reading RM 999.00). The ruling's third clause -- 'the cancelled Work points at its successor' -- is delivered on the user_direct arm only; on the two no-successor arms superseded_by is NULL and the reason survives only inside a derived op-key string. The brief's 'Needs-you shows the replacement' is delivered on no arm (measured: zero rows for either the retired Work or the successor).
ruling_885.replaced_by: On the clara_interpreted arm and on every arm where clara.restate_accounting_work refuses CLR10/CLR13, 're-admitted on the corrected facts' is replaced by 'RETIRED, and the person restates': the Work is cancelled with no successor, the receipt carries replaced:false plus not_replaced_reason ('interpreted_basis' or the door's own reason such as 'source_already_posted'), and the only telling is a transient banner on the correcting surface -- ClientDocuments.factsRevisionWorkNotReplaced, 'its figures were read from the value you just corrected, so somebody has to give the instruction again.' On the user_direct arm it is replaced by 'RE-ADMITTED ON THE SAME INSTRUCTION against the corrected document', with the consequence stated at the answering surface only ('a figure that has to change needs a new restatement') and nothing enforcing it.
ruling_885.honest_minimum: For the clara_interpreted arm: YES, retiring is the honest minimum, and both alternatives are closed at the SQL seam by measurement rather than by argument. (1) Re-deriving the basis is not constructible in SQL: packages/runtime/workflows/claraWork.v1.tools.ts journalBasisSchema is posting_date + memo + currency + lines of integer cents with no back-link from a line to a document field_path, so mapping a corrected invoice.total onto debit/credit lines is an interpretation act, not a projection. (2) The adversarial reviewer's own second option -- 'admit it in a state that cannot post until a human re-states' -- is ALSO not constructible: parking the successor on a confirmation question needs clara.open_work_question, whose step (4) is a conditional transition `update clara.agent_tasks set status='awaiting_input' where id = p_task and status = 'running'` and which raises CLR13 task_not_running otherwise (0184_work_cancel_ordering.sql:1641-1653); a freshly admitted successor's task is queued, and only the runtime's clara.claim_work_run moves it to running. So the correcting door genuinely could not have re-admitted on corrected facts without reaching into a frozen body or minting a fake run claim, and `node scripts/check-frozen-workflows.mjs` in the lint chain confirms no frozen body was touched. BUT the same reasoning is NOT applied consistently: it justifies retiring a derived basis, and the lane then auto-admits a user_direct successor that carries an unreviewed pre-correction figure and can post it. The honest minimum for that arm would have been either the same retirement, or an explicit owner ruling that a human's stated figure survives a correction of the document it was read from. The lane took the second position without asking, and recorded it only inside the migration header's prose.
ruling_885.remainder: (1) RE-ADMISSION ON CORRECTED FACTS for a clara_interpreted basis -- nobody derives a corrected basis today; the estate has no seam for it below the runtime. This belongs to the wave-4 shared cut (chatTurn_v22 / claraWork_v6), and the lane recorded NO contract for it: wave2-lane09-fix.md §6's three contracts are a first-class cancellation reason on 0199's door, a better convergeCancelled sentence keyed on it, and the SupersededWork web type -- none names the derivation. §6 is therefore NOT enough to finish the ruling at wave 4; the contract that is missing is 'on a source correction, who re-reads the corrected document and proposes the corrected basis, and what the retired Work is linked to while that is pending'. (2) THE user_direct SUCCESSOR carries a pre-correction figure no human re-confirmed after the correction, can post it, and cannot post the corrected one -- owner ruling needed on whether that is intended, and if it is, a durable record on the successor (not just a sentence on the answering surface) that its figures predate the correction. (3) THE #676 CARVE-OUT leaves a question about the corrected document answerable when the Work already posted -- measured ACCEPTED; the brief carves it out and the ruling forbids it, so the owner must say which sentence wins. (4) 'NEEDS-YOU SHOWS THE REPLACEMENT' (Agent Brief, Desired behavior) is not delivered on any arm and has no cell. (5) A FIRST-CLASS RETIREMENT REASON (L09-SPEC-07) so #840's feed and the answering surface can say WHY a Work was retired instead of string-parsing source_corrected:<revision>:<work>. Items (1), (4) and (5) are already visible in the lane's records; (2) and (3) are new here and are the two reasons #885 cannot close as DONE.
